# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2016

**An Ordinance Creating the Local Housing Board Defining Its Powers and Functions and for Other Similar Purposes**

## Summary

Creates the Local Housing Board for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] pursuant to RA 7279 (Urban Development and Housing Act / UDHA). The ordinance aims to ensure a prosperous and dynamic social order with affordable and adequate housing for all residents. It promotes anti-squatting measures and references LGU obligations to carry out socialized housing programs. Also references RA 7835.

## Key Provisions

- **Creation of Local Housing Board:** Establishes the body responsible for housing policy and programs in Pitogo
- **Powers and Functions:** Defines the scope of authority of the Local Housing Board
- **Socialized Housing:** Mandates LGU implementation of socialized housing programs per RA 7279 (UDHA)
- **Anti-Squatting Measures:** Promotes orderly settlement and addresses informal settler concerns
- **Affordable Housing:** Ensures provision of affordable and adequate housing for residents

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Paulino S. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
- [[Local Housing Board]]
